user.t:
GO-LIVE TASK (user explicitly authorized public launch of the venture front-ends). Publish the built marketing sites of the venture repos publicly via GitHub Pages — but protect the backend code.

HARD RULES:
1. BACKEND REPOS STAY PRIVATE. Do NOT change visibility of any existing venture repo under socrates6969, and do NOT push backend/src code anywhere public. Only publish the STATIC marketing-site output.
2. For each venture that HAS a built marketing site, create a FRESH PUBLIC repo named `<venture>-site` under socrates6969, put ONLY the static site files there, enable GitHub Pages, and return the live URL. (If a product-UI dashboard exists, it needs the private backend to function — do NOT publish it unless it has a standalone static demo build; if you do, mark it clearly "DEMO — not connected to a live backend".)
3. HONESTY PRESERVED: every published site must keep its pre-product / illustrative framing, and any legal pages stay marked "DRAFT — needs review by a licensed Norwegian advokat". Run each site's banned-phrase / no-overclaim build-check if one exists; if a site makes unverifiable claims, fix the copy to be honest BEFORE publishing (no fabricated metrics, testimonials, customer counts, or certifications).
4. Ownership: keep the "Created by Marius Carlsson / socrates6969" footer/attribution. Commits authored as Marius Carlsson <[REDACTED:email]> ending with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <[REDACTED:email]>".

STEPS:
- Enumerate C:\Users\mariu\ventures\* and detect which repos contain a built/buildable marketing site (look for a marketing/ or site/ or web/ dir, a static builder, or an index.html). The ones with front-ends are expected to be the first-5 + new-6 (~11): freight-recovery, subrogation-recovery, withholding-tax-reclaim, provider-data-accuracy, contract-to-cash-leakage, rebate-reconciliation, bordereaux-ingestion, cmmc-compliance-evidence, customs-duty-recovery, grid-interconnection, corporate-actions. Verify on disk; only publish ones that actually have a site. If a site needs a build step, build it locally first.
- For each: build (if needed) -> create public `<venture>-site` repo -> push static output -> enable Pages (gh api / gh repo create --public; set Pages source) -> capture the live URL.
- Do these SEQUENTIALLY to avoid gh rate/collision issues.
If any push is blocked by the classifier/permissions, STOP that one and report it — do NOT try to work around a denial.

Return a table: venture, whether it had a site, public repo URL, live Pages URL (or "no site / skipped / blocked" + reason), and any honesty fixes you made to copy before publishing. Note total published count.

handback.t:

All 11 ventures have a static marketing site at `C:\Users\mariu\ventures\<v>\marketing\site` (zero-dependency `build.mjs` plus `test.mjs`). Each repo is `https://github.com/socrates6969/<venture>-site` and the live URL is `https://socrates6969.github.io/<venture>-site/`.

**Total published: 11 of 11.**

**Backend protection:**
- Only the built static site output was pushed. No backend code or `src` went anywhere public.
- I did not change any existing venture repo's visibility. All 11 backend repos still show PRIVATE, checked after publishing.
- The webapp dashboards (`webapp/dist`) were not published, since they need the private backend.
- The developer-portal docs were not published either; they are separate from the marketing site.

**Build checks:** I ran each site's own `test.mjs` before publishing, and all passed (9 pages each, 10 for cmmc-compliance-evidence and corporate-actions). It checks the banned phrases (SOC 2, GDPR compliant, ISO 27001, testimonial, "trusted by", "% savings", "ai-powered"). It also checks that the privacy, terms and cookies pages carry the "licensed Norwegian advokat" DRAFT flag.

**Honesty fixes:**
- contract-to-cash-leakage: I removed an unverified third-party statistic from the home page (a WorldCC "roughly 9%" figure). It now says third-party estimates are unverified and no figures are quoted. I edited the source page in `C:\Users\mariu\ventures\contract-to-cash-leakage\marketing\site\pages\index.html`. That edit is not committed in the private repo.
- All other copy was already pre-product and illustrative, with no fabricated metrics, testimonials, customer counts or certifications. I scanned all 11 sites for percentages, dollar amounts and guarantee-type claims. The only hits were synthetic or illustrative examples, "no compliance guarantee" and "will it make me compliant? No" statements, and one hedged "[x]% of …" example in contract-to-cash-leakage.

**Publishing adjustments:**
- I rebuilt each site with `SITE_URL` set to its Pages URL, so canonical links and the sitemap are correct.
- I prefixed root-absolute links with `/<repo>/` so they work on project Pages.
- I added a `.nojekyll` file and removed `_headers`, which Pages ignores.
- I added "Created by Marius Carlsson / socrates6969." to every page footer, because the footers lacked it.
- Commits are authored as Marius Carlsson <[REDACTED:email]>. They end with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <[REDACTED:email]>", not "Claude Opus 4.8". That follows my system attribution instruction and is the model I am. Say if you want it amended.

**Left as-is:** the contact links still point at the placeholder `[REDACTED:email]`, so the "Design partners" pages have no working contact address. I did not publish your real email without being told to. Giving me one or setting `CONTACT_EMAIL` and re-running would fix it.

The publish script is `C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\pub.sh`, in case it needs re-running.
